# pve_appliance_templates (Data Source)

Turnkey appliance templates available on a node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_appliance_templates" "example" {
node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
- `templates` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /nodes/{node}/aplinfo (the API schema does not describe its shape).
